hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester 1 builds strong foundations in communication, AI tools, and global business, while preparing students with essential leadership, planning, and career skills.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines practical finance and digital marketing skills with AI and communication training, unlike traditional MBAs’ theory-focused and less tech-integrated approach.
